instruction: The Android Clock app has a `Delivery` alarm. Please open `/tmp/delivery/schedule.xlsx` in LibreOffice Calc on the first Linux machine, find the Delivery row and fill in the alarm time, then create a notification draft in Thunderbird on the second Linux machine.
surfaces: Android Clock app + linux_0 Calc + linux_1 Thunderbird
setup_note: Android 创建 Delivery alarm；linux_0 准备 schedule.xlsx；linux_1 准备 Thunderbird draft。
evaluate_note: 检查 Calc 单元格和 Thunderbird draft 内容。
fixture_notes: /tmp/delivery/schedule.xlsx has in-place workbook cell evaluator rules
schedule.xlsx includes delivery-team@example.test as the draft recipient cue
Thunderbird draft must contain the recipient, alarm label, and alarm time
